# CityMETER · Office

> Office records across Thailand by district (เขต/อำเภอ): organisations' own office premises, rental office buildings and components, and managed-workspace centres, with the median of the starting asking rents that public listings show (THB per m² per month), straight-line distance to rail stations (CityMETER Transit), the organisations the research sheet links to each office and a rent comparison set per office. A Landometer CityMETER public demo, release 0.1.0 (2026-11-05). Research master checked 2026-11-02.

What one figure means:
- offices (แห่ง) = Office IDs of the research master's 01_OFFICES: an office premises, building or component. A workspace centre inside a host building is its own record, and an Office ID can be a few floors of a building, so a count of offices is never a count of buildings or of floor area. Not a census; the register has no national denominator.
- rent = the starting asking rent a public listing shows (28_OFFICE_METRICS.rent_min_thb_sqm_month), THB per m² per month, with its listing month (May–October 2026). Not a contract, achieved or average rent; VAT and service-charge inclusion is mostly not verified.
- median rent of an area = the median of the dated asking rents of its offices, only from 5 of them; with fewer the area shows how many rents it has, never a median.
- recorded price (เดิม) = the legacy CityMETER production price (THB per m², period not stated), shown per office only where no monthly rent is selected; never in a measure.
- floors, area = the building's storeys and the source area with their status and basis (GLA/GFA often unstated).
- organisations = roles of 19_ORGANIZATION_ROLES (office user, operator, workspace provider or network, leasing brand, published portfolio, property manager, rental provider), source claims — not a verified tenancy, ownership or occupancy.
- distances = straight lines between reference points, not walking routes or catchments.
- districts = CityMETER production districts (codes as in https://landometer.com/v3/citymeter/{province}/D/{district}?d=office).
